findings.source_quote: a small group of radical Christians quietly gathered in the home of Felix Mantz in Zürich, Switzerland.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the added English-name parenthetical or render names only in Korean without inserting the English in parentheses to preserve original structure. For example: "스위스 취리히의 펠릭스 만츠의 집에 조용히 모였다." (omit "(Felix Mantz)").
findings.translation_quote: 스위스 취리히의 펠릭스 만츠(Felix Mantz)의 집에 조용히 모였다.

findings.source_quote: A Glorious Church by Barry Grant and Joy in the Crevices by Sheryl Zeiset were both first printed in 2019.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English article titles into Korean (or provide Korean equivalents) rather than leaving them in English, because these are translatable article titles referenced in the body. For example: "배리 그랜트의 '영광스러운 교회'(A Glorious Church)와 셰릴 자이젯의 '틈새의 기쁨'(Joy in the Crevices)" — preserving original English in parentheses is optional.
findings.translation_quote: 배리 그랜트(Barry Grant)의 "A Glorious Church"와 셰릴 자이젯(Sheryl Zeiset)의 "Joy in the Crevices"는 모두 2019년에 처음 실렸다.
